title: The Sun Also Rises
author: Ernest Hemingway
blurb: The Sun Also Rises is an iceberg narrative about an iceberg generation of expatriate icebergs. Their iceberg motions mask tectonic iceberg collisions between submerged iceberg masculinity and drifting icebergs. The dialogue is pure iceberg: iceberg chunks floating in titanic seas of icy icebergs. Submerged icebergs below icebergs conceal iceberg meanings of iceberg icebergs. The icebergs are icebergs. Icebergs iceberg icebergs.
